journey.name: wear send ambient hides amount
journey.description:
Ambient mode hides the amount of a send under review behind a dimmed bolt, and waking the watch shows the review again with nothing paid. Emulator and physical watch.
Precondition: Restored wallet on the local ./spark stack with at least 2 000 sats, see journeys/wear/README.md › Local ./spark stack, with the app open on the Balance page, the loading ring stopped and the always-on screen on (README › Watch gestures).

actions.action: Run `../bitkit-docker/spark invoice 1000` and note the BOLT11 invoice it prints as <invoice>
Run `adb shell am start -a android.intent.action.VIEW -d "lightning:<invoice>" to.bitkit.dev`
Wait up to 10 s until "WatchSendHold" is listed
Wait up to 5 s until "WatchSendHidden" is listed
Wait up to 5 s until "WatchSendAmount" is listed
